description: Detect vouchers booked twice (same document number, or same supplier + amount within a few days) and vouchers left in Entwurf/offen status. Read-only.

dayWindow.description: How many days apart two same-amount vouchers may be to count as duplicates (default 7).

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

name: sevdesk_find_duplicates
title: Find duplicate and stuck vouchers
